sentences.text: Emma Charlotte Duerre Watson -LRB- born 15 April 1990 -RRB- is a French-British actress , model , and activist .

Born in Paris and brought up in Oxfordshire , Watson attended the Dragon School and trained as an actress at the Oxford branch of Stagecoach Theatre Arts .	Oxfordshire	Oxfordshire	Dragon School	Dragon School	Oxford	Oxford	Stagecoach Theatre Arts	Stagecoach Theatre Arts

She rose to prominence after landing her first professional acting role as Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter film series , having acted only in school plays previously .	Hermione Granger	Hermione Granger
Watson appeared in all eight Harry Potter films from 2001 to 2011 , earning worldwide fame , critical accolades , and around $ 60 million .	critical accolades	Accolade

Watson continued to work outside of the Harry Potter films , lending her voice to The Tale of Despereaux -LRB- 2008 -RRB- and appearing in the 2007 television adaptation of the novel Ballet Shoes .	The Tale of Despereaux	The Tale of Despereaux (film)	television adaptation	Ballet Shoes (film)	Ballet Shoes	Ballet Shoes (novel)

Since then , she has taken on starring roles in The Perks of Being a Wallflower -LRB- 2012 -RRB- and The Bling Ring -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , made a brief appearance as an exaggerated version of herself in This Is the End -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , and portrayed the title character 's adopted daughter in Noah -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .	The Perks of Being a Wallflower	The Perks of Being a Wallflower (film)	The Bling Ring	The Bling Ring	This Is the End	This Is the End	Noah	Noah (2014 film)
In 2017 , she portrayed Belle in a live-action adaptation of Beauty and the Beast .	Belle	Belle (Disney)	Beauty and the Beast	Beauty and the Beast (2017 film)

Her other releases include Regression -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , Colonia -LRB- 2015 -RRB- and The Circle -LRB- 2017 -RRB- .	Regression	Regression (film)	Colonia	Colonia (film)	The Circle	The Circle (2017 film)

From 2011 to 2014 , Watson split her time between working on film projects and continuing her education , studying at Brown University and Worcester College , Oxford and graduating from Brown with a bachelor 's degree in English literature in May 2014 .	Brown University	Brown University	Oxford	Oxford	English literature	English literature
Her modelling work has included campaigns for Burberry and Lancôme .	Burberry	Burberry	Lancôme	Lancôme
As a fashion consultant , she helped create a line of clothing for People Tree .

She was honoured by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts in 2014 , winning for British Artist of the Year .	British Academy of Film and Television Arts	British Academy of Film and Television Arts

That same year , she was appointed as a UN Women Goodwill Ambassador and helped launch the UN Women campaign HeForShe , which calls for men to advocate gender equality .	UN Women	UN Women	Goodwill Ambassador	Goodwill Ambassador	HeForShe	HeForShe	gender equality	gender equality
